x: Jimmy Bellchamber, the Club's first great long distance walker, finished 2nd in the Brighton and Back race in 1921 in 20hrs. 53mins. 35secs. and so became our first Centurion.

At the A.G.M. of that year (1931) Jimmy Bellchamber was elected President and during his address said "All of Harry's work for the Club, whether as an athlete, Secretary, President or Treasurer, has in reality been Club building in the truest sense of the word, and it has consequently borne the imprint of permanence".
